note: The worksets and phases Sportify uses. Sportify makes the worksets itself (Phasing & Worksets > Set Up Phases & Worksets, and on import); Revit's API can neither create nor rename a phase, so the phases are named once by hand in Manage > Phasing. This file is kept equal to the add-in's own lists by Tools/run-checks.js.

worksets.name: Sportify Existing Roof Base
worksets.holds: the roof as it stands: the base of an import

worksets.name: Sportify Structure
worksets.holds: grid, columns, beams and bearing walls, and the frame of a Kinetics unit

worksets.name: Sportify Gardens
worksets.holds: garden parcels, planting and their build-ups

worksets.name: Sportify Furniture
worksets.holds: benches, stands and other static furniture

worksets.name: Sportify Dynamic Furniture
worksets.holds: the moving parts Kinetics places from the analyses: louvres, screens, sails, roller fences

importWorksets.name: Sports
importWorksets.holds: what an import of a layout brings for sports

importWorksets.name: Gardens
importWorksets.holds: what an import of a layout brings for gardens

importWorksets.name: Combine
importWorksets.holds: the combined layout: paths, boundaries and the rest

phases.name: Existing
phases.holds: the building and the roof as they stand (the project's first phase, whatever it is called)

phases.name: Design and analysis
phases.holds: what an import from the web app brings: the layout being designed and analysed

phases.name: Post analysis
phases.holds: the dynamic furniture Kinetics places from the results of the analyses
